scope: Accept the fixed two-carrier design for independent implementation, source review and one necessary tiny synthetic admission check. No real model, original QA capture, fitting, generation or activation is authorized by this review.
findings: This is an independent functionality question: replace the complete original up matrix by row-scaled reuse of the retained gate preactivation plus a rank199 residual, compared with an independently represented rank200 up. It is not merely restoration of the closed role/rank200 q/v experiment.

The fitted Static carrier is necessary: both arms receive the same lawful current S1 groups, sampled teacher states and complete original gate/down output targets, with the same fixed fitting exposures, updates and optimizer policy.

Static has 21504 more complete weight coefficients. The protocol correctly calls this near-matched within the Static upper budget, with no unused parameter padding; it is not exact parameter equality.

Rowwise regression and residual SVD provide a concrete initialization without retaining the original up matrix. They do not establish that gate and up functions are aligned, that the residual is small, or that full effective rank preserves answering.
The design includes actual all-24-layer physical substitution, complete save/reload and whole-model Answer F1. A local feature MSE improvement alone cannot pass the predeclared quality decision.

32 fit groups and 16 disjoint feature-check groups use fixed representatives and positions. Captured input/output samples are selected before allocation and subject to the fixed payload cap; no future FIT or DEV fitting is permitted.

Reusing the prior unadapted parent scores avoids a new parent evaluation only if the original proof, full parent state, runtime/input sources, exact IDs/references and actual per-ID prepared inputs are bound. A binding failure stops rather than silently changing the reference.

The fixed 1200+2400+2400-second model ceilings cover capture, initialization, fitting, complete packages, reload and 200 generations. First STARTED failure/interruption/nonfinite/timeout closes the point without a parameter, data, cap or recovery search.
required_implementation_controls: Physically delete all original up matrices from final registered state and serialized model graph; do not retain dense residuals or full SVD bases. Reuse the same computed Gx rather than executing a second gate projection.

Count every retained base weight, required weight buffer, row-scale and residual factor with shared storage deduplicated. Report ordinary buffers, container bytes, fitting masters and runtime memory separately.

Keep all original G/D and other base parameters frozen; fit only the declared d/A/B or Static A/B. Verify the common sampled states, held-group isolation, fixed optimizer/update schedule, finite gradients and actual parameter changes.

Implement the stated FP32-master/FP16-forward/final-FP16 path explicitly and test the actual serialization/reconstruction route in the necessary synthetic gate. CPU success must not be reported as actual CUDA or Answer F1 validation.
Bind the copied parent F1 through the existing VERIFIED and parent prediction SHA without rerunning the old scorer, and check actual evaluation-input digest equality in the eventual unique verifier.

Score each new arm prediction exactly once only after all phases complete with successful budgeted exits and fixed integrity checks. No partial quality consumption or automatic subsequent continual training.
limitations: This design tests whether a specific gate-preactivation reuse carrier can preserve a useful starting function. It does not establish a novel shared-factor principle, PAS/OSFT causal mechanism, or a completed paper framework.

The preactivation Gx is a linear response reused inside the original nonlinear gate/down composition; it should not be described as a proven semantic dictionary or as unchanged actual gates throughout the modified network.

Original teacher states are local calibration inputs. Replacing all layers changes downstream input distributions; only the actual reloaded whole-model test addresses the resulting answering behavior.
Both carriers may fail, even if held-out local feature MSE improves. Success over a damaged Static baseline is insufficient without the protocol’s five-domain parent point floor.

The two carriers have different initial functions and slightly different coefficient counts; their difference is a structural allocation comparison, not a pure causal test of learning ability or routing.

A positive point retains this smaller starting carrier for a separate finite-budget adaptation review only. It provides no existing proof of subsequent plasticity, forgetting performance or superiority to trained strong references.

Previously explored DEV, one seed and 20 QA per domain cannot support noninferiority, equivalence, stability or significance claims. Failure applies to these fixed conditions, not all gate-sharing or low-rank representations.
This review performed only a read of the actual protocol and standard-library hashing/writing. No model, Torch, QA, score, synthetic gate or experiment was executed.
